import pyagrum as gum
bn = gum.BayesNet("Wet grass")
bn.add(gum.LabelizedVariable("you run sprinkler", "", ["yes", "no"])) bn.add(gum.LabelizedVariable("rain", "", ["yes", "no"])) bn.add(gum.LabelizedVariable("wet grass", "", ["yes", "no"]))
bn.addArc("you run sprinkler", "wet grass") bn.addArc("rain", "wet grass") bn.addArc("rain", "you run sprinkler")
bn.cpt("you run sprinkler")[{"rain": "yes"}] = [0.2, 0.8] bn.cpt("you run sprinkler")[{"rain": "no"}] = [0.8, 0.2]
bn.cpt("rain").fillWith([0.8, 0.2])
bn.cpt("wet grass")[{"you run sprinkler": "yes", "rain": "yes"}] = [0.99, 0.01] bn.cpt("wet grass")[{"you run sprinkler": "yes", "rain": "no"}] = [0.8, 0.2] bn.cpt("wet grass")[{"you run sprinkler": "no", "rain": "yes"}] = [0.99, 0.01] bn.cpt("wet grass")[{"you run sprinkler": "no", "rain": "no"}] = [0, 1]
